g.text: Required-slot macro metrics by task category
AI-provisional slot labels, unchanged by the task adjudication overlay
Macro = arithmetic mean of the per-task metric; the change panel has one task per configuration.
CORRECT -> TP; WRONG -> FP and FN; MISSING -> FN. No biological efficacy or strict C1 planning claim.
Human VEGFA / ARPE-19 | Seen development tasks | 2026-10-28
